descriptions.notStarted: Bicho in Happyville looks too weak to make a snowman all by himself, but he is doing quite well so far. But it seems like he is looking for someone.
descriptions.inProgress: Bicho asked you to find the person who helped him make the snowman. He said that the person is somewhere in Maple World.\n\nHis friend's name is #b#Q4490##k
descriptions.completed: Due to Bicho's misunderstanding, you were not able to find the Mapler who had helped him earlier. Wait, Bicho is thinking of another name now? You should go visit him!
